name: 2-XL
definition: Talking educational toy robot sold by Mego from 1978 to 1981 and by Tiger Electronics from 1992 to 1995, regarded as the first smart toy.

name: 360 Eye
definition: Dyson's tank tracked vacuum with a panoramic camera crown.

name: 4NE-1
definition: Europe's leading commercial humanoid effort, built on Neura's cognitive robot stack.

name: 5DX
definition: Automated inspection robot, made by Hewlett Packard and later Agilent Technologies, that took 3D radiographic images of assembled circuit boards to check the solder.

name: 8A4 class ROUV
definition: Remotely operated underwater vehicle of the work class type, developed by China's Shenyang Institute of Automation for jobs ranging from oil platform servicing to salvage and rescue.

name: ABISMO
maker: Japan Agency for Marine-Earth Science and Technology
definition: Japanese deep sea remotely operated vehicle built by the Japan Agency for Marine-Earth Science and Technology as the replacement for Kaikō, which was lost in 2003.

name: ACM III
definition: Snake robot built by Shigeo Hirose, among the first machines to crawl by undulating its body like a real snake.

name: Actroid
definition: Highly lifelike android created at Osaka University and produced by Kokoro, usually given the appearance of a young Japanese woman.

name: ADAM
definition: Two armed beverage robot that mixes and serves drinks in arenas, hotels and hospitals, leased to venues as a staffed kiosk replacement.

name: Adelbrecht
definition: Ball shaped robot that could talk and interact with people, designed by Martin Spanjaard.

name: Aeo
definition: A wheeled care humanoid patrolling Japanese eldercare homes with UV lamps and soft grippers.

name: AEON
definition: An industrial humanoid from the metrology giant, aimed at scanning and inspection work.

name: Aerones
definition: Rope suspended robotic system that climbs wind turbine blades to clean, inspect, test lightning conductors and repair leading edges.

name: AESOP
definition: Robotic arm that held and moved the endoscope camera during keyhole surgery, the first surgical robot cleared by the US Food and Drug Administration.

name: Affetto
definition: Research robot developed at the University of Osaka in Japan, first built in 2012.

name: AgBot 2.055W4
definition: Wheeled diesel electric autonomous tractor with a three point hitch and power take off that works pre planned field routes without a driver.

name: AgiBot A2
definition: Interactive service humanoid from a Shanghai company, holder of the Guinness record for the longest continuous walk by a humanoid robot.

name: Agile ONE
definition: Humanoid robot introduced in 2025 by Agile Robots, a robotics company from Germany.

name: AI Suitcase
definition: Navigation robot in the form of a suitcase that guides people with visual impairments, developed in 2021 as part of a museum artificial intelligence project.

name: Ai-Da
definition: Humanoid robot artist, completed in 2019 by Engineered Arts, that produces drawings, paintings and sculptures.

name: aibo ERS-1000
definition: Sony's revival of its robot dog, a twenty two axis home companion with camera based recognition and cloud connected behaviour.

name: AIBO ERS-110
definition: Sony's first consumer robot dog, an eighteen joint autonomous quadruped sold as an entertainment pet rather than a research machine.

name: AIBO ERS-7
definition: Consumer entertainment robot in Sony's AIBO series, released in 2003 as the first model the company explicitly presented as a dog.

name: Aiko Chihira
definition: Humanoid android from Toshiba that greeted shoppers as a receptionist at a Mitsukoshi department store in Tokyo.

name: Air-Cobot
definition: Wheeled collaborative robot from a French research project, built to check aircraft during maintenance while working alongside human staff.

name: AISoy1
definition: Consumer pet robot from Spain's AISoy Robotics, counted among the first with emotional learning, whose decisions weigh logical and emotional factors rather than fixed replies.

name: Ajeeb
definition: Fake chess automaton built by cabinet maker Charles Hooper, which appeared to play on its own while a skilled human player hidden inside made the moves.

name: Albert HUBO
definition: Walking humanoid robot that mounts a head on a full size two legged frame, based on the HUBO biped from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology.

name: Alex
definition: An upper body humanoid from IHMC lineage, aimed at manipulation research and industry.

name: Alice
definition: Tiny cube shaped mobile robot measuring 2 by 2 by 2 cm, created at the Autonomous Systems Lab of the École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne.

name: Aliengo
definition: The research quadruped that carried Unitree into universities worldwide.

name: Allen
definition: Wheeled research robot that Rodney Brooks's group built in the late 1980s, the first they based on the subsumption architecture.

name: Alpha Mini
definition: A palm sized educational humanoid teaching coding in classrooms.

name: AlphaDog
definition: Chinese quadruped platform marketed for education, security and delivery work, launched with claims of unusually high running speed.

name: ALPHRED 2
definition: Radially symmetric four limbed robot from UCLA that walks in any direction, uses two limbs as arms and can roll on its feet.

name: Alter 3
definition: An android artist with a neural network nervous system; conducted an opera.

name: Amazon Scout
definition: Six wheeled cooler sized sidewalk delivery robot that Amazon field tested in four United States neighbourhoods before ending the programme in 2022.

name: Ameca
definition: The grey faced expressive android whose stunned expressions became the face of the AI era.

name: Amiga
definition: Modular open source electric farm robot with adjustable track width, used by small farms and researchers to carry tools, sensors and custom implements.

name: AMOR
definition: Autonomous robot built for outdoor operation at the University of Siegen in Germany, working without direct human control.

name: AN/WLD-1 Remote Minehunting System
definition: Remote controlled mine hunting system from Lockheed Martin in which an unmanned semisubmersible vehicle tows a sonar array under the direction of a surface warship.

name: Andromeda
definition: Surgical robot developed to carry out parts of procedures autonomously rather than only extending a surgeon's hands.

name: ANDROS
definition: Family of remote controlled ground robots from Remotec, a Northrop Grumman subsidiary, used by military, bomb disposal and police teams.

name: Andy Warhol Robot
definition: Animatronic figure of Andy Warhol that the artist created in 1981 to serve as a self portrait.

name: ANYmal
definition: The industrial inspection quadruped patrolling offshore platforms and plants, offered in explosion proof form.

name: ANYmal B
definition: First ANYmal generation, a sealed electric quadruped with torque controlled joints sold to research groups and early industrial pilots.

name: ANYmal C
definition: Industrial version of ANYmal, packaged for autonomous inspection rounds in power plants, chemical works and offshore facilities.

name: ANYmal D
definition: Current ANYbotics inspection quadruped, a fifty kilogram sealed machine that walks industrial plants on its own and returns to dock.

name: ANYmal X
definition: The explosion proof ANYmal certified for oil, gas and chemical plants.

name: Aoi Erika
definition: Android announcer created for the television network Nippon TV, introduced in 2017 and standing 166 cm tall.

name: Apollo
definition: A warehouse humanoid designed around swappable batteries and friendly form language; piloted with Mercedes-Benz and GXO.

name: Aquanaut
definition: Underwater robot that cruises as an autonomous vehicle and then opens into a two armed remotely operated vehicle at its work site.

name: Arachno-Bot
maker: Fraunhofer Institute of Manufacturing Engineering and Automation
definition: Eight legged spider inspired robot developed in 2011 at the Fraunhofer Institute of Manufacturing Engineering and Automation in Stuttgart to survey areas too dangerous for people.

name: Archie
definition: Teen sized humanoid robot over 120 cm tall, developed from 2004 by TU Wien in Austria and the University of Manitoba in Canada.

name: Argo
definition: Uncrewed camera sled towed deep underwater, developed by Robert Ballard at Woods Hole's Deep Submergence Laboratory, that helped find the wreck of the Titanic in 1985.

name: Argus
definition: Robotic camera platform from MIT's City Scanning project that captured omnidirectional images tagged with their geographic position, dating from 1990.

name: ARI
definition: A wheeled social humanoid built for reception desks and human robot interaction studies.

name: ARMAR-6
definition: A collaborative wheeled humanoid that hands tools to technicians and learns from demonstration.

name: ARMAR-III
definition: Kitchen oriented humanoid from Karlsruhe with 43 degrees of freedom on a holonomic wheeled base, used for household manipulation research.

name: Armatron
definition: Joystick controlled toy robot arm from Tomy, sold through Radio Shack stores in the United States from 1984, with no automatic functions.

name: Armored Combat Engineer Robot
definition: Tracked military robot from Mesa Robotics, about as big as a small bulldozer with a weight of 2.25 tons, used to clear obstacles and explosives and haul cargo.

name: ARTOS
definition: Autonomous robot for transport and service tasks, developed at the University of Kaiserslautern in Germany.

name: Ascento Guard
definition: A two wheeled jumping security robot balancing on legs with wheels for feet.

name: Aseon Pod
definition: Robotic micro depot that charges, cleans and services self driving cars between trips.

name: ASIMO
definition: The world's most famous walking robot for two decades; retired to museum duty in 2022.

name: ASRA C1
definition: Sony's dual armed cooking research robot developed with Carnegie Mellon.

name: Astro
definition: A household monitor upon wheels; a camera, a screen and a disposition, sold as a home robot.

name: AstroAnt
definition: Matchbox sized magnetic wheeled robot designed to crawl over a lunar rover's surface and take thermal readings while it drives.

name: Astrobee
definition: System of three cube shaped free flying robots from NASA's Ames Research Center that helps astronauts with routine chores aboard the International Space Station.

name: Asuro
definition: Programmable robot able to act autonomously, carrying out behaviours that its user writes and loads as software.

name: Atalante
definition: Self balancing exoskeleton from Wandercraft that lets people with paralysis walk without crutches.

name: ATHLETE
definition: A six limbed wheel legged lunar cargo hauler that rolls or walks as terrain demands.

name: Atlas (electric)
definition: The all electric successor to the hydraulic Atlas; unveiled for enterprise material handling at CES 2026.

name: Atlas (hydraulic)
definition: The hydraulic research humanoid whose parkour and backflips defined a decade of legged robotics.

name: Atom
definition: A desktop arm maker's leap to full humanoids, priced to undercut the field.

name: ATRIAS
maker: Oregon State University, Dynamic Robotics Laboratory
definition: Spring mass biped from Oregon State built to test whether a legged robot could match the dynamics and efficiency of running birds.

name: ATRIS
definition: Four wheeled outdoor patrol robot used for security rounds at Chinese industrial parks and substations, carrying cameras, thermal imaging and lidar.

name: Audi Lunar Quattro
maker: Planetary Transportation Systems and Audi AG
definition: Small German lunar rover developed in 2015 by engineers of the PTScientists team, with backing from Audi and partners in several countries.

name: Automower 450X
definition: The descendant of the world's first robotic lawn mower, three decades on the job.

name: Autonomous Benthic Explorer
definition: Autonomous underwater vehicle operated by the Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution that surveyed broad stretches of seabed down to 4500 m until its loss at sea in 2010.

name: Autonomous Shipboard Humanoid
definition: Humanoid robot developed at the United States Naval Research Laboratory with Virginia Tech and the University of Pennsylvania to move around ships, climb ladders and fight fires.

name: AutoPallet
definition: Swarm of small mobile robots that move cardboard boxes and install into existing warehouses.

name: AUV ABYSS
definition: REMUS 6000 autonomous underwater vehicle built by Hydroid in 2008 and owned by GEOMAR, used to map the deep seabed and gather data from the water column.

name: AUV-150
definition: Indian autonomous underwater vehicle under development by scientists at the Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute in Durgapur, West Bengal, with support from IIT Kharagpur.

name: Ava 500
definition: Autonomous office telepresence robot from iRobot that drove itself to a chosen meeting room, using video equipment from Cisco.

name: Avadin
definition: Care robot for older people developed by the South Korean company Wonderful Platform, also known by the name Dasom.

name: AvantGuard
definition: Modular unmanned ground combat vehicle developed by G-NIUS Unmanned Ground Systems in Israel for military use.

name: Avatar
definition: Series of unmanned tactical ground robots built by the company Robotex and listed as military equipment.

name: Avride
definition: The delivery rover formerly of Yandex, ferrying food across campuses with Grubhub.

name: Avride delivery robot
definition: Six wheeled sidewalk delivery robot that carries Uber Eats orders in several United States cities, navigating autonomously with remote operators available to assist.

name: Axle Robot Kit
definition: Robot kit from the American company True Robotics that students in grades 6 to 8 build for classroom learning.

name: Azalea
definition: Robots that load and sort checked luggage in airport baggage halls.

name: B2-W
definition: A wheeled variant of the B2 that skates stairs and slopes on powered hubs.

name: Ballie
definition: A rolling home companion ball with a built in projector, launched after six years of teasers.

name: Banryu
definition: Robot product model developed in Japan and manufactured by the electronics company Sanyo.

name: Battlefield Extraction-Assist Robot
definition: Remote controlled humanoid robot from Vecna Robotics built to carry wounded soldiers off the battlefield, using strong hydraulics to lift people over rough ground and stairs.

name: Baxter
definition: Two armed collaborative industrial robot from Rethink Robotics, the startup founded by Rodney Brooks, that has an animated face.

name: BB-8 by Sphero
definition: App controlled rolling toy modelled on the droid from the 2015 Star Wars film, a ball with a magnetically held head.

name: Beam
definition: The telepresence pioneer that let Edward Snowden wander conference stages.

name: Bear Flag autonomous tractor
definition: Retrofit kit that turned existing farm tractors and implements into driverless machines; the company was acquired by Deere.

name: Bee-Bot
definition: Educational robot intended for use in teaching, giving learners a physical machine to experiment with during lessons.

name: BellaBot
definition: Four tray delivery robot with a cat like animated face, used in restaurants and hotels to carry dishes to tables and clear them away.

name: Benthic Rover II
definition: Autonomous tracked seafloor rover that has monitored carbon cycling on the abyssal plain off California for years at a time.

name: Berkeley Lower Extremity Exoskeleton
maker: Berkeley Robotics and Human Engineering Laboratory
definition: Lower body powered exoskeleton developed by the Berkeley Robotics and Human Engineering Laboratory at the University of California, Berkeley, with DARPA funding, to add strength to leg movements.

name: Bex
definition: A rideable robot ibex that carries a person on its back and kneels on wheels.

name: BHR-2
definition: Second generation Beijing Institute of Technology humanoid that performed tai chi and broadsword forms to demonstrate whole body balance control.

name: Big Mouth Billy Bass
definition: Singing animatronic novelty in the form of a largemouth bass, created by Gemmy Industries and widely popular from the late 1990s into the early 2000s.

name: BigDog
definition: The gasoline engined pack mule whose recovery from a kick announced the legged robot age.

name: BINA48
definition: Humanoid robot head with chatbot software for basic conversation, built by Hanson Robotics in 2010 and made to look like Bina Aspen.

name: Bio-Intelligent Cyborg Insect
definition: Biohybrid robotic system that steers living insects without surgery by using ultraviolet light, relying on their natural tendency to move away from it.

name: BionicKangaroo
definition: Kangaroo shaped jumping robot from Festo that, like the animal, recovers energy from each hop and puts it into the next.

name: BISAM
definition: Mammal like four legged walking machine from Karlsruhe, built to study adaptive gait control with an articulated trunk.

name: Bistrobot
definition: Automated sandwich line from a San Francisco startup that assembled orders while customers watched.

name: Bittle
definition: Palm sized programmable robot dog kit with nine powered joints, sold as an education platform for coding and robotics classes.

name: Black Knight
definition: Prototype unmanned ground combat vehicle from BAE Systems, resembling a tank, weighing about 12 tons and armed with a 30 mm gun, under evaluation by the US Army.

name: Bluefin-21
definition: Autonomous underwater vehicle from Bluefin Robotics for defence, commercial and scientific tasks, best known for its part in the 2014 hunt for Malaysia Airlines Flight 370.

name: BlueROV2
definition: Modular underwater remotely operated vehicle from the American company Blue Robotics, offered at low cost and run on open source control software.

name: BlueWhale
definition: Israeli unmanned underwater vehicle, designated ELI-3325, built by an ELTA Systems and Atlas Elektronik joint venture to gather intelligence using radar and signals intelligence equipment.

name: Boaty McBoatface
definition: British autonomous underwater vehicle belonging to the Autosub Long Range class, run by the National Oceanography Centre for scientific research.

name: Boe-Bot
definition: Wheeled educational robot kit sold by Parallax, built around a BASIC Stamp microcontroller board with two servo driven wheels on an aluminum chassis.

name: Boost
definition: Autonomous mobile manipulator that inspects and services equipment in data centers.

name: Booster T1
definition: Mid size developer humanoid sold to universities and robot sports teams, widely used in RoboCup humanoid league competition.

name: Bossa Nova 2020
definition: Walmart's shelf scanner fleet, cancelled overnight when the retailer changed course.

name: Bossa Nova shelf scanning robot
definition: Tall camera tower on a wheeled base that scanned supermarket shelves for gaps and pricing errors, best known from a large Walmart rollout.

name: BotBuilt
definition: Robotic cells that assemble wall panels and roof trusses for house framing.

name: Botvac D7
definition: The laser mapping vacuum pioneer whose maker closed in 2023.

name: Braava
definition: Roomba's quiet mopping sibling for hard floors.

name: Bridget
definition: Airbus Mars rover testbed used in the Stevenage Mars Yard and in Atacama Desert trials of European rover autonomy software.

name: BRUIE
definition: Buoyant two wheeled rover that drives upside down along the underside of ice, tested in Antarctic and Alaskan lakes.

name: Buddharoid
definition: Japanese robot monk created by Kyoto University researchers with technology company partners to give Buddhist spiritual guidance, unveiled at a temple in Kyoto.

name: Buddy
definition: A French emotional companion robot aimed at classrooms and eldercare.

name: Bumi
definition: Small consumer biped launched at about 1,370 dollars, the cheapest walking humanoid offered by an established maker at the time.

name: Burro
definition: A self driving farm cart following grape pickers down vineyard rows.

name: CA-1
definition: Autonomous robotic cooking system introduced in 2025 by the German company Circus SE.

name: CA-M
definition: Autonomous provisioning system for military operations, introduced in 2025 by the German company Circus SE.

name: CADRE
definition: Set of three suitcase sized solar rovers built to explore the Moon as an autonomous team sharing a single radar measurement.

name: Cafe X
definition: Robotic coffee kiosk in which an arm pulls espresso drinks ordered from a phone or touchscreen, first opened in San Francisco.

name: Calvin 40
definition: An industrial humanoid grown from a decade of self balancing exoskeleton engineering.

name: Canadarm
definition: Family of robotic arms built by SPAR Aerospace of Canada that Space Shuttle orbiters carried to release, move and capture payloads in orbit.

name: Canadarm2
definition: Robotic arm of the International Space Station, built in Canada, that moves end over end between fixtures and captures visiting cargo ships.

name: Canadarm3
definition: Robotic system planned for the Gateway lunar space station, combining a large arm, a small dexterous arm and tools, built by MDA for the Canadian Space Agency.

name: Care-O-bot 4
definition: A gentleman butler service robot with a bowing torso and tray hands.

name: Carl
definition: Robot in the form of a compliant robotic leg, built at the University of Kaiserslautern in Germany.

name: Cartken Model C
definition: Six wheeled sidewalk robot that delivers food and light goods using camera based navigation, deployed on campuses and city streets in North America, Europe and Japan.

name: Cassie
definition: A pair of bird legs with no torso; set a bipedal 100 metre record and begat Digit.

name: Cat 793F CMD
definition: Large diesel mining haul truck built to run driverless under Caterpillar's fleet control system, hauling ore and overburden in open pit mines.

name: CC1
definition: A quadruple function commercial cleaner that scrubs, sweeps, vacuums and mops.

name: Charge Robotics
definition: Robots that automate the most repetitive work of building utility scale solar farms.

name: CHARLI-2
maker: Virginia Tech, Robotics and Mechanisms Laboratory
definition: Lightweight full size humanoid built by students at Virginia Tech that won the adult size soccer competition at RoboCup 2011.

name: Cheetah
definition: Tethered hydraulic quadruped built for DARPA that set the land speed record for a legged robot on a laboratory treadmill.

name: Cheetah-cub
definition: Cat sized compliant quadruped from EPFL that was the fastest small four legged robot of its time relative to body size.

name: CHIMP
maker: Carnegie Mellon University National Robotics Engineering Center
definition: Anthropomorphic disaster response robot from Carnegie Mellon that rolls on limb mounted tracks and rises on its rear limbs to use tools.

name: CHiP
definition: Toy robot dog that rolls on spherical wheels and follows its owner using a wristband.

name: Chuck
definition: Cart shaped collaborative robot that leads warehouse pickers along a batched pick path and carries up to about 91 kg of totes.

name: CIMON
definition: Head shaped robot with artificial intelligence, built by Airbus in Germany as a crew companion aboard the International Space Station.

name: CISBOT
definition: Pipe repair robot that travels inside cast iron natural gas mains and seals their joints from within, so the pipes need not be dug up.

name: CivDot
definition: Battery electric surveying rover that drives to precise coordinates and marks each point with paint, laying out pile positions on solar construction sites.

name: CLOi ServeBot
definition: LG's shelf carrying restaurant and building courier line.

name: Clone Alpha
definition: A water powered synthetic muscle android of unsettling anatomical fidelity.

name: Cobalt
definition: An indoor security robot pairing patrols with a human specialist on video.

name: COBOTTA
definition: Portable six axis collaborative arm from Denso light enough to be carried and set up on a desk.

name: Coco
definition: A remote piloted delivery cart working restaurant districts of Los Angeles and beyond.

name: Coco 2
definition: Second generation urban delivery robot that runs on sidewalks, bike lanes and roads, carrying restaurant and grocery orders with onboard autonomy and remote oversight.

name: Cog
definition: Upper body humanoid at MIT built to test the argument that human like intelligence has to be learned through embodied social interaction.

name: Colmena
definition: Swarm of five palm sized Mexican micro robots intended to self organise on the lunar regolith, lost with the Peregrine lander.

name: Colossus
definition: French robot built for firefighting, meant to help fire services by taking on fire suppression work.

name: COMAN
definition: Compact humanoid from IIT with springs in every major joint, built to study how passive compliance aids balance and efficient walking.

name: Compressorhead
definition: Robot rock cover band whose members are animatronic machines, created by Berlin based artist Frank Barnes and several collaborators.

name: Cool Robot
definition: Solar powered four wheeled robot designed to tow instrument sleds across polar snowfields through the continuous daylight of summer.

name: Copperhead
definition: Family of autonomous underwater vehicles from Anduril, offered in two size classes, each with a utility version and a single use munition version.

name: CORLEO
definition: A hydrogen powered rideable quadruped concept steered by the rider's body.

name: Cornell Ranger
maker: Cornell University, Biorobotics and Locomotion Laboratory
definition: Ultra efficient walking robot from Cornell that covered 65.2 km without stopping or being touched, drawing about 16 watts of power.

name: Cosmic-1
definition: Autonomous heavy lift robot from Cosmic Robotics that installs solar panels; the company also works on lunar construction under a NASA contract.

name: CosmoBot
definition: Prototype telerehabilitation robot intended for therapy with children who have conditions such as autism, Down syndrome, cerebral palsy or muscular dystrophy.

name: COTSBot
definition: Small autonomous underwater vehicle from Queensland University of Technology that finds crown of thorns starfish on the Great Barrier Reef and kills them by injection.

name: Cotton Candy Dan
definition: Animatronic clown prop shown stirring cotton candy, sold by the retailer Spirit Halloween for the 2024 Halloween season.

name: Courier
definition: A sidewalk robot from ex-Google engineers, also working indoor factory routes in Japan.

name: Cozmo
definition: A toy forklift with the soul of a Pixar character; a million sold before its maker folded.

name: Create 3
definition: The Roomba stripped for parts and sold as an education research base.

name: Creator
definition: Automated burger line that ground, cooked and assembled burgers to order at a San Francisco restaurant that opened in 2018.

name: Creoqode NOVA
definition: Educational robot model from the British company Creoqode, intended for teaching and learning about robotics.

name: Cruzr
definition: A wheeled service humanoid staffing receptions and retail floors.

name: CRX-10iA
definition: Lightweight collaborative arm from FANUC programmed by dragging it by hand or with a tablet interface.

name: CRX10
definition: Self navigating mobile robot platform from South Korean company CNRobot, intended for teaching, training and research and first shown in May 2011.

name: CubeRover
definition: Class of small modular planetary rovers developed by Astrobotic Technology, applying the CubeSat approach of standard, inexpensive off the shelf parts.

name: CubeStormer 3
definition: Rubik's Cube solving robot made from Lego Mindstorms and a Samsung Galaxy S4 that set a world record of 3.253 seconds in March 2014.

name: CubeStormer II
definition: Rubik's Cube solving robot built mostly from Lego Mindstorms parts with a Samsung Galaxy S2, made by Mike Dobson and David Gilday for ARM Holdings.

name: CUE
definition: A basketball shooting humanoid holding a Guinness record for consecutive free throws.

name: Curiosity
definition: The car sized nuclear laboratory still climbing Mount Sharp after a decade.

name: CURV-21
definition: Remotely operated underwater vehicle of the United States Navy, built for deep ocean salvage work at depths of up to 20,000 feet (6,100 m).

name: CURV-III
definition: US Navy remotely operated recovery vehicle, fourth in the CURV series, that made the deepest underwater rescue on record by saving two men trapped in a submersible in 1973.

name: CyberDog
definition: Xiaomi's first quadruped, released as a limited run of one thousand units for developers at 9,999 yuan.

name: CyberDog 2
definition: A doberman sized successor that learns tricks from demonstration.

name: CyberKnife
definition: Radiation treatment system that mounts a linear accelerator on a robot arm to aim beams at tumours from many angles.

name: CyberOne
definition: Xiaomi's emotional full size humanoid, sibling to its CyberDog line.

name: D7
definition: A wheeled semi humanoid bridging Pudu's delivery machines and true bipeds.

name: da Vinci 5
definition: Fifth generation da Vinci system, cleared in the United States in 2024, adding force feedback instruments.

name: da Vinci SP
definition: Version of the da Vinci system that passes a camera and three instruments through a single small incision.

name: da Vinci Surgical System
definition: Surgical robot system made by Intuitive Surgical for minimally invasive operations, including prostate removal, heart valve repair and kidney and gynaecological procedures.

name: da Vinci Xi
definition: Fourth generation da Vinci system with arms mounted on an overhead boom, so the robot can reach several parts of the abdomen without being moved.

name: DAL-e
definition: A wheeled customer service humanoid greeting visitors in Hyundai showrooms.

name: Dante I
definition: Eight legged tethered walking robot sent into the crater of Mount Erebus in Antarctica, which failed a few metres into its descent.

name: Dante II
definition: Tethered eight legged volcano robot that descended more than 200 metres into the crater of Mount Spurr in Alaska in 1994.

name: Darwin
definition: Robot technician being built to assemble, commission and maintain data center hardware, with first deployments targeted for 2027.

name: DARwIn-OP
definition: The open platform mini humanoid that carried university RoboCup teams for a decade.

name: Dash
definition: Small wheeled robot programmed from a tablet with visual blocks, made to teach young children to code.

name: DEEBOT X1 OMNI
definition: Home vacuum and mop robot paired with a station that empties its dustbin, washes the mop pads and refills the water tank automatically.

name: Deebot X2
definition: A square cornered flagship vacuum reaching where round robots cannot.

name: Deep Drone
definition: Remotely operated salvage submersible used by the United States Navy, able to work at depths of up to 8,000 feet with sonar and two manipulator arms.

name: DeLaval VMS
definition: Voluntary milking system in which a robot arm attaches the teat cups as each cow enters the stall.

name: Denise
maker: Delft University of Technology, Delft Biorobotics Laboratory
definition: Passive dynamic walking biped from Delft driven by pneumatic muscles, notable for walking on a small fraction of the energy typical robots need.

name: DEPTHX
definition: Autonomous underwater vehicle that Stone Aerospace of Austin, Texas, built to map and sample flooded sinkholes in northern Mexico, as a NASA funded step toward exploring Europa.

name: Dexter
definition: Compact surgical robot from Distalmotion that hospitals can switch between robotic and ordinary keyhole surgery during a single operation.

name: Dextre
definition: Robotic telemanipulator with two arms on the International Space Station, built by MDA Space to handle repair work that would otherwise call for spacewalking astronauts.

name: Digesting Duck
definition: Mechanical duck built by Jacques de Vaucanson that seemed to eat grain and excrete it, although the droppings were stored in advance and nothing was actually digested.

name: Digit
definition: A warehouse humanoid built for the handling of totes; among the first of its kind to work paid shifts, logging over one hundred thousand cycles.

name: Dilly
definition: Korea's food delivery robot rolling through Seoul apartment complexes.

name: DINERBOT T8
definition: The restaurant robot leader's flagship server, delivering in ninety countries.

name: Dingo
definition: An indoor research base light enough for a lab bench.

name: Discovery
definition: Remotely operated underwater vehicle built in Britain by Specialist Machine Development for use in China; little has been published about it.

name: Dive-LD
definition: Large diameter autonomous underwater vehicle made by Anduril Industries for defence and commercial work at sea, able to reach 6,000 metres on missions lasting up to 10 days.

name: DIY Kindle Scanner
definition: Lego Mindstorms machine built by Peter Purgathofer that works with a computer and a Kindle reader to copy electronic books, sidestepping their copy protection.

name: Dobot Magician
definition: Small four axis desktop arm that can draw, laser engrave and 3D print, used widely in schools.

name: Domo
definition: Experimental humanoid robot built at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology by Jeff Weber and Aaron Edsinger to interact with people.

name: Don Cuco El Guapo
definition: Piano playing robot created in 1992 by the microelectronics department of the Universidad Autónoma de Puebla in Mexico.

name: Double 3
definition: The self balancing tablet on a stick that lets remote workers roam the office.

name: Double Eagle
definition: Remotely operated underwater vehicle built by the Swedish defense company Saab Underwater Systems for disposing of naval mines, in use with several navies.

name: Dragon Runner
definition: Small throwable ground robot for urban combat, developed at Carnegie Mellon University with US Marine Corps funding and fitted with QinetiQ electronics and casing.

name: DRC-Hubo+

name: Eelume

name: Ekso

definition: Chess automaton created by the Spanish engineer Leonardo Torres Quevedo that played out a reduced endgame with three pieces entirely on its own.

name: Figure 03

name: Fingerlings

name: HaiPick

definition: Building and coding set from LEGO with a motorised hub and a colour and distance sensor, used to make five starter robots.

name: LEGO Education SPIKE Prime
definition: Classroom robotics set from LEGO Education built around a programmable hub with six ports for motors and sensors.

name: Lego Mindstorms EV3
definition: Programmable robotics kit from the Lego Group, the third generation of the Mindstorms line, announced at CES in January 2013 and succeeding the NXT.

name: Lego Mindstorms NXT
definition: Robot building and programming kit from Lego, launched in August 2006 as the second generation of Mindstorms after the Robotics Invention System.

name: LEGO Mindstorms RCX
definition: First LEGO Mindstorms programmable brick, which brought robot building with motors and sensors to children and hobbyists.

name: Lely Astronaut
definition: Milking robot from the Dutch firm Lely, in which cows walk in to be milked whenever they choose with no farmer present.

name: Leonardo
definition: Social robot standing 2.5 feet tall, built by MIT's Personal Robots Group to study interaction and collaboration between humans and robots.

name: LEV-1
definition: Small hopping robot released from JAXA's SLIM lander in January 2024 that relayed pictures taken by its companion SORA-Q back to Earth.

name: LeVO
definition: Autonomous pallet jack built by the American company Atlas Robotics to move pallets without a human operator.

name: LeVO 3D
definition: Autonomous industrial truck that serves as a stacker and reach truck, part of the LeVO line from the American company Atlas Robotics.

name: LeVO Double Fork
definition: Autonomous pallet jack with a double fork, a variant of the LeVO made by the American company Atlas Robotics.

name: Lewis
definition: Autonomous robot photographer from the Media and Machines Laboratory at Washington University in St. Louis that roams social events taking pictures of guests.

name: LG CLOi GuideBot
definition: Airport and lobby guide robot with a large touch screen that answers questions in several languages and escorts visitors to their destination.

name: LG Roboking
definition: Line of robotic vacuum cleaners made by LG, sold as Roboking in Korea and under the Hom-Bot name in other markets.

name: Liberdade class underwater glider
definition: Experimental class of blended wing body underwater gliders developed by the US Office of Naval Research, originally meant to track quiet diesel electric submarines in coastal waters.

name: Lightweight Rover Unit
maker: DLR Institute of Robotics and Mechatronics
definition: German four wheeled research rover used in Mount Etna campaigns to test autonomous lunar style survey and sample collection.

name: LimX Oli
definition: Full size humanoid sold in tiered configurations from about 21,800 dollars, aimed at embodied intelligence research and commercial development work.

name: Lingxi X1
definition: AgiBot's open source modular humanoid, released with drawings and code.

name: Lingxi X2
definition: A nimble small humanoid that rides bicycles and skateboards in viral demonstrations.

name: LittleDog
definition: Small electric quadruped supplied to university teams as the shared hardware of the DARPA Learning Locomotion programme.

name: Locus Origin
definition: Collaborative picking robot that carries totes to warehouse workers and shows pick instructions on a screen so people stay inside one zone.

name: Lokomat
definition: Robotic gait trainer that moves a patient's legs over a treadmill while part of their body weight is supported by a harness.

name: LOLA
definition: Munich research biped built for fast walking, with 25 actuated joints and a light structure that reached 3.34 km/h in experiments.

name: Looj
definition: Domestic robot made by the American consumer robot company iRobot, the firm behind the Roomba robotic vacuum cleaners.

name: Loomo
definition: A hoverboard that transforms into a following robot companion.

name: Loona
definition: A crowdfunded petbot that plays fetch and argues via a language model.

name: LOVOT
definition: A warm bodied companion robot engineered solely to be loved.

name: LR Mate 200iD
definition: Compact six axis arm from FANUC, one of the most widely installed small industrial robots.

name: LS3
definition: Large hydraulic pack quadruped developed for DARPA and the US Marine Corps to carry squad equipment on foot patrols.

name: Luba AWD
definition: All wheel drive robot mower that navigates by satellite positioning instead of a boundary wire.

name: LuckiBot
definition: A greeter and guide service robot leading guests to tables and rooms.

name: Lucky the Dinosaur
definition: Roaming Disney animatronic figure of a green Segnosaurus, about 2.4 m tall, that hauls a cart decked in flowers while a handler leads it.

name: Lunar Roving Vehicle
maker: Boeing with General Motors Delco for NASA
definition: Battery powered four wheeled car driven by Apollo astronauts on the Moon, extending each crew's exploration range far beyond walking distance.

name: Lunokhod 1
definition: First robotic rover to operate on another world, driving 10.5 kilometres across Mare Imbrium for the Soviet Luna 17 mission.

name: Lunokhod 2
definition: Second Soviet lunar rover, delivered by Luna 21 to Le Monnier crater, which drove roughly 39 kilometres in under four months.

name: Lunokhod 3
definition: Third generation Lunokhod completed in 1977 for a mission that was never funded, now preserved as a museum exhibit near Moscow.

name: LUPEX rover
definition: Tracked lunar rover from Mitsubishi Heavy Industries of Japan for the Lunar Polar Exploration Mission, weighing 350 kg and measuring 2 m long.

name: Luzi
definition: Individual Pepper robot given the name Luzi and operated by ZHB Luzern in Switzerland.

name: Lynx
definition: A wheel legged all terrain machine that skates, walks and climbs.

name: M-2000iA
definition: Very large six axis arm from FANUC that can lift car bodies and other loads weighing more than two tonnes.

name: M1013
definition: Collaborative arm from Doosan Robotics with torque sensors in all six joints.

name: MABEL
maker: University of Michigan with Carnegie Mellon University
definition: Boom constrained biped at Michigan that used springs in series with its motors to run at 3.06 m/s, a record for a robot with knees.

name: Maestro
definition: Pair of robotic arms from Moon Surgical that hold the camera and retract tissue for the surgeon during keyhole surgery.

name: MAGGIE
definition: Engineering test rover, its name short for Mars Automated Giant Gizmo for Integrated Engineering, used by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory as an Earth testbed for NASA's Curiosity rover.

name: MagicBot
definition: A production line humanoid family also shown running and doing acrobatics.

name: MAGPIE
definition: Lunar rover being developed by ispace for the European Space Agency to look for water ice near the Moon's south pole.

name: MAHRU
maker: Korea Institute of Science and Technology
definition: Humanoid robot developed by the Korea Institute of Science and Technology that draws its artificial intelligence from networks, created together with the related robot AHRA.

name: Mahru-Z
maker: Korea Institute of Science and Technology
definition: KIST humanoid built for household chores, using three dimensional vision to recognise objects and operate appliances with its own hands and feet.

name: Mako
definition: Robotic arm system that guides surgeons cutting bone for knee and hip replacements according to a plan made from a CT scan.

name: Manav
definition: Humanoid robot developed in India, built with a body modelled on the human form.

name: Manifold
definition: Drop in robotic labor from a 2026 Y Combinator company.

name: Mantis
definition: Autonomous robot from the American company Atlas Robotics that works as a pallet jack and can also pick individual cases.

name: MAPP
definition: Commercial prospecting rover carrying a cellular network demonstration to the Moon, stranded aboard the IM-2 lander after it tipped over.

name: Marble
definition: Sidewalk delivery robot tested in San Francisco, whose maker was acquired by Caterpillar in 2020.

name: MARCbot
definition: Remote controlled military robot made by Exponent Inc. for the United States Army's Rapid Equipping Force.

name: Marie Curie
definition: Flight spare twin of the Sojourner microrover, built for Mars Pathfinder and later used for engineering work before museum preservation.

name: Mark II
definition: Rideable robot controlled by its riders, made by the US company MegaBots and first shown at Maker Faire San Mateo in May 2015.

name: Marker
maker: Russian Foundation for Advanced Research Projects in the Defense Industry
definition: Robotic platform from Russia, known there as Маркер, developed by the Russian Foundation for Advanced Research Projects in the Defense Industry.

name: MarkV-A1
definition: Remotely operated bomb disposal robot designed by Northrop Grumman to handle suspected explosives without putting people at risk.

name: Marsokhod
definition: Soviet designed six wheeled rover chassis used in Russian, French and American field trials at volcanoes and deserts through the 1990s.

name: Marty
definition: Grey tower robot with googly eyes that roams supermarket aisles looking for spills and hazards and checking shelves for stock and price errors.

name: Marvin
definition: Indoor mobile research robot from the Robotics Lab at the University of Kaiserslautern, using laser scanners, ultrasonic sensors and a camera to navigate and map rooms.

name: MASCOT
definition: Shoebox sized lander carried by Hayabusa2 that used an internal swinging arm to hop across asteroid Ryugu in 2018.

name: Matic
definition: A camera only home vacuum that maps like a self driving car and keeps data on device.

name: MATILDA
definition: Remotely operated scouting and surveillance robot made by Mesa Robotics, sold in versions such as Urban Warrior, Block II and Scout.

name: Maurice
definition: Small home robot from Innate with a single arm, designed to be taught new chores through code, language and demonstration.

name: Max
definition: Wheel legged quadruped from Tencent's robotics laboratory that switches between walking on four legs and rolling on wheels.

name: Maya AUV
definition: Indian autonomous underwater vehicle built by the marine instrumentation team at the National Institute of Oceanography.

name: Mazor X
definition: Robotic guidance system for spine surgery from Mazor Robotics, which Medtronic acquired in 2018.

name: mBot
definition: Line of toy robot kits for children made by the Chinese company Makeblock.

name: Meca500
definition: Very small six axis industrial arm from Mecademic, sized for laboratory automation and electronics assembly.

name: Meccanoid
definition: Buildable humanoid robot kit from Meccano that learns movements by recording poses its owner moves it through.

name: Mech
definition: A twin armed industrial superhumanoid on a lifting base, built for truck loading in heat and cold.

name: Mechanical Turk
definition: Hoax chess automaton built by Wolfgang von Kempelen whose apparent skill came from a chess master concealed inside, moving the pieces with levers and magnets.

name: Meinü robot
definition: Female humanoid robot from China, reported by Chinese news outlets in 2006, whose Mandarin name is officially rendered in English as beauty robot.

name: MEISTeR
definition: Remotely controlled maintenance robot from Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, built for work inside the damaged Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant.

name: Melody (Aria)
definition: A modular companion android with swappable faces, sold for connection rather than labour.

name: MenteeBot
definition: A household and warehouse humanoid trained end to end on language to motion models.

name: Mephisto
definition: Chess playing machine passed off as an automaton, built in London by Charles Godfrey Gumpel, an Alsatian maker of artificial limbs, and first exhibited in 1878.

name: Mezli
definition: Fully automated restaurant built into a shipping container that cooked meals for takeout and delivery.

name: Mi Robot Vacuum
definition: Laser mapping robot vacuum sold by Xiaomi and made by Roborock, which brought lidar navigation to a low price.

name: Michelangelo Hand
definition: Robotic prosthetic hand with full articulation made by the German company Ottobock with its American partner Advanced Arm Dynamics, the first prosthesis with an electronically driven thumb.

name: Milo
definition: Small expressive humanoid robot used to teach social and emotional skills to children with autism.

name: Miloš
maker: Military Technical Institute Belgrade and Prva Petoletka
definition: Serbian unmanned ground vehicle developed by the Military Technical Institute after its earlier Milica vehicle of 2009 and built in series for the Serbian Armed Forces.

name: Mindar
definition: Android at the Kōdai-ji Zen temple in Kyoto that preaches regularly on the Heart Sutra and was made to personify Kannon, the bodhisattva of compassion.

name: MINERVA
definition: Series of Japanese rovers built by JAXA to explore the surfaces of asteroids, carried on the Hayabusa and Hayabusa2 missions.

name: MINERVA-II1
definition: Pair of small rovers released by Hayabusa2 onto asteroid Ryugu in 2018, the first rovers to move across the surface of an asteroid, which they did by hopping.

name: Mini Cheetah
definition: Nine kilogram electric quadruped built from modular actuators, the first four legged robot shown performing a backflip.

name: Mini Pupper
definition: A ROS native open source desktop quadruped crowdfunded by hobbyists.

name: Mini Pupper 2
definition: Small open source quadruped kit built around a Raspberry Pi and ROS 2, aimed at students learning navigation and mapping.

name: Mini Rover ROV
definition: Tethered underwater remotely operated vehicle created by Chris Nicholson of Deep Sea Systems International, introduced in 1983 as the first compact and inexpensive ROV.

name: Minitaur
definition: A springy direct drive quadruped that climbed fences and opened doors on legs alone.

name: Minsky's Tentacle Arm
definition: Robot arm dating from 1965, built to imitate a human arm and now exhibited at the MIT Museum.

name: MiP
definition: Self balancing toy robot that rides on two wheels, carries a small tray and responds to hand gestures.

name: MiPA
definition: A wheeled household and care humanoid intended for serial production in Europe.

name: MiR250
definition: Low profile 250 kg autonomous mobile robot for factories and hospitals, built to slide under carts and shelves or carry custom top modules.

name: MiRo
definition: Social robot made by the British company Consequential Robotics, intended to interact and communicate with people.

name: Mirokai
definition: Character styled service robot that balances on a single ball, trialled in Paris hospitals for carrying samples, linens and small deliveries.

name: Mission Master SP
definition: Eight wheeled hybrid electric military ground vehicle that carries cargo or sensors, following soldiers or driving waypoint routes with a human in the loop.

name: Misty II
definition: A developer platform desk robot with a programmable personality.

name: MIT Cheetah 2
definition: Electric bounding quadruped that ran untethered on grass and jumped hurdles, built to show motors could match hydraulics.

name: MIT Cheetah 3
definition: Forty kilogram electric quadruped that climbed cluttered stairs and jumped onto tables using only proprioception, with no cameras.

name: MIT Quadruped
definition: Hydraulic running quadruped from Marc Raibert's MIT Leg Laboratory that trotted, paced and bounded using a decomposed balance controller.

name: MIT-Manus
definition: Arm rehabilitation robot from MIT that guides a patient's hand through reaching exercises after stroke, later sold under the InMotion name.

name: Mitra
definition: Humanoid robot from Bangalore startup Invento Robotics that made its debut at the Global Entrepreneurship Summit in November 2017, where it welcomed Ivanka Trump.

name: Mobot
definition: Mechanical robots that tap and swipe real phones to test mobile apps where emulators fall short.

name: Modular Advanced Armed Robotic System
definition: Armed military ground robot developed by QinetiQ as part of the TALON family, intended to succeed the SWORDS robot on a larger chassis.

name: Modulus
definition: Domestic robot developed from 1984 by Sirius, a company founded by Massimo Giuliana, with an exterior designed by the Milan based Japanese designer Isao Hosoe.

name: Moflin
definition: Furry palm sized companion robot that develops its own character as it responds to touch and voice.

name: Molecubes
definition: Modular robot system from Cornell University made of cubes with two rotating halves that can be joined together into many different shapes.

name: Moley Robotic Kitchen
definition: Pair of ceiling mounted arms with dexterous hands that cook recipes recorded from human chefs.

name: Momaro
definition: Centaur like robot from the University of Bonn with four legs ending in wheels and two arms, built for the DARPA Robotics Challenge.

name: Mona
definition: A whimsical care focused humanoid designed for homes rather than factories.

name: Monarch
definition: Robotic platform for bronchoscopy developed by Auris Health, which Johnson and Johnson acquired in 2019.

name: Monarch MK-V
definition: Battery electric compact utility tractor with driver optional autonomy, sold for vineyards, orchards and dairies, with cameras for row following and safety.

name: MoonRanger
definition: Suitcase sized autonomous lunar rover built to scout hundreds of metres from its lander without waiting for driving commands.

name: Morphle
definition: Robotic microscopes from Bengaluru that automate slide scanning for cancer diagnostics.

name: Motoman HC10
definition: Collaborative arm in the Yaskawa Motoman range with hand guided teaching and pinch point protection.

name: Moxi
definition: Hospital service robot with a single arm and an expressive head, leased to health systems to fetch and deliver supplies for nurses.

name: Moxie
definition: Companion robot developed and produced by the company Embodied and later discontinued.

name: MTGR
definition: Small Israeli military ground robot whose name stands for Micro Tactical Ground Robot.

name: MULE
definition: Autonomous unmanned ground combat vehicle developed by Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control for the United States Army's Future Combat Systems effort.

name: Multiply Labs
definition: Cloud controlled modular robotic system that manufactures individualized drugs, a process normally done by hand.

name: Muppet Mobile Lab
definition: Free roving animatronic attraction created by Walt Disney Imagineering and trialled at Disney theme parks in Anaheim, Orlando and Hong Kong.

name: Murata Boy and Murata Girl
definition: Pair of self balancing robots built by Japanese electronic components maker Murata Manufacturing to demonstrate its products and attract publicity.

name: MUSA
definition: Kendo fighting robot completed in July 2005 by the Manufacturing and Mechatronics Lab of Seoul National University under Professor Young-Bong Bang.

name: Musio
definition: Social robot from AKA Intelligence that converses with people to help them practise spoken English, recognising objects, reading facial expressions and showing expressions of its own.

name: myCobot 280
definition: Palm sized six axis arm from Elephant Robotics sold for teaching and hobby projects.

name: Myon
maker: Humboldt University of Berlin, Neurorobotics Research Laboratory
definition: Modular humanoid from Berlin whose limbs can be detached and keep working, built for research on distributed neural style control.

name: Mytos
definition: Robotic platform that turns stem cells into specific cell types such as neurons and heart cells over several weeks.

name: N1
definition: An open source compact humanoid released with full build files.

name: N2
definition: A knee high acrobatic biped that finished second in Beijing's robot marathon.

name: Nadia
definition: A boxing trained research humanoid with human like range of motion, built with Boardwalk.

name: Nadine
definition: Lifelike female humanoid social robot whose looks are based on Professor Nadia Magnenat Thalmann, able to recognise people, remember past conversations and answer questions in several languages.

name: NAO
definition: Small programmable biped sold in large numbers to schools, universities and research labs, and long the standard platform for RoboCup soccer leagues.

name: Navel
definition: Social robot developed by the German company navel robotics for use in care facilities.

name: Navibot
definition: Robot vacuum from Samsung that worked out its position by photographing the ceiling with an upward facing camera.

name: Navimow
definition: Wire free robotic lawn mower that uses satellite positioning to stay inside a mapped area, aimed at residential lawns in Europe and North America.

name: Nazir
maker: Islamic Republic of Iran Army Ground Forces
definition: Remote controlled armed robot built by Iran's Army Ground Forces that carries two missiles and about 600 kg of cargo, first unveiled in September 2015.

name: NeCoRo
definition: Robot built in the form of an animal and sold as a product by the Japanese company Omron.

name: Neo
definition: Self driving floor scrubbing machine for large indoor sites that maps a building once and then repeats cleaning routes without an operator.

name: NEO
definition: Soft bodied household humanoid sold for early access delivery from 2026, with a tendon drive and optional remote human operation for unfamiliar chores.

name: Neo 2
definition: A self driving floor scrubber mapping airports and malls each night.

name: Neolix X3
definition: Low speed cabless electric delivery van used for parcels, groceries and vending on Chinese public roads under Level 4 autonomy with remote supervision.

name: Nereus
definition: Hybrid uncrewed underwater vehicle from the Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution, made for research at full ocean depth, which reached the floor of the Challenger Deep in 2009.

name: NeuroArm
definition: Research robot for neurosurgery, the first image guided surgical robot compatible with magnetic resonance imaging that can carry out both microsurgery and stereotaxy.

name: Neuromorphic
definition: Mobile robot that moves between wet lab benches and operates existing scientific instruments like a technician.

name: Nexi
definition: Mobile, dexterous and social robot from the MIT Media Lab Personal Robots Group, with an expressive face on a self balancing wheeled base.

name: NEXTAGE
definition: Dual arm humanoid torso sold for precision cell production, working at benches alongside people in electronics and precision assembly plants.

name: NICOBO
definition: A shy tail wagging cushion robot that speaks in half formed words.

name: Nomad
definition: Car sized Carnegie Mellon field rover that drove 215 kilometres across the Atacama Desert and later searched Antarctica for meteorites.

name: Nomad 200
definition: Commercial mobile robot made by Nomadic Technologies in the 1990s, with a choice of sensors, chiefly for robotics lab courses and research and development.

name: Nori
definition: American made humanoid announced at a price of $1,688.

name: Nova 5
definition: Autonomous search and rescue robot created by engineer brothers Fady and Sami Khaled that uses a fuzzy neural network to make sense of its surroundings and find its own way.

name: Nuro R2
definition: Cabless road going electric delivery pod with no seats or steering wheel, used for grocery and pizza delivery in Texas, Arizona and California.

name: Nuum
definition: Snake like robot that travels inside machinery to inspect and maintain it.

name: Ocado 600 Series Bot
definition: Grid running grocery picking robot from Ocado, much lighter than its predecessors and built partly from 3D printed parts.

name: Ocean Aero Triton
definition: Autonomous vessel from the American company Ocean Aero that can travel both on the surface and underwater, propelled by solar and wind power for long missions.

name: OceanOneK
definition: A haptic humanoid diver that explores shipwrecks a kilometre down while its pilot feels what it touches.

name: Octobot
definition: Autonomous robot made of soft materials, built by a Harvard University team to show the approach could work and described in Nature in 2016.

name: Odin
definition: Robot arms placed in small and mid sized factories for machine tending and packing, working beside existing machines and people.

name: OhmniCare
definition: Telepresence robot for clinics and care homes with a tall touchscreen and four cameras, driven by a remote clinician from a browser.

name: Omnibot
definition: Toy robot first made by Tomy in the mid 1980s, whose name later covered a whole line of the company's robots.

name: OmniTread
definition: Segmented serpentine robot covered in moving treads on all sides, so it can push through rubble whichever way it lands.

name: OMRON LD-250
definition: Industrial autonomous mobile robot that carries 250 kg of parts between machines and stores using laser mapping instead of floor tape or magnets.

name: Opentrons Flex
definition: Larger successor to the OT-2 launched in May 2023, adding a gripper that moves labware between deck positions.

name: Opportunity
definition: Twin of Spirit that landed in Meridiani Planum, confirmed water altered bedrock and drove 45 kilometres over more than fourteen years.

name: OPTIMISM
definition: Full scale Earth twin of Perseverance kept in JPL's Mars Yard to rehearse drives and debug problems with the flight rover.

name: Optimus
definition: Full size electric humanoid that Tesla is developing for factory and general labour tasks, currently used only inside Tesla facilities.

name: Orangewood Labs
definition: San Francisco maker of low cost robot arms and the software that lets them learn new tasks.

name: Orb Swarm
definition: Kinetic art piece made up of six partly autonomous spherical robots, built in 2007 by engineers and artists to imitate natural swarms and human dance.

name: Orca
definition: Autonomous underwater vehicle being developed by Boeing and Huntington Ingalls Industries for the United States Navy.

name: Origami hand
definition: High degree of freedom direct drive robotic hand from Origami Robotics, matched to a glove like device that records human demonstrations.

name: OS3
definition: Low cost mobile humanoid designed and built in the United States by a two person team.

name: OT-2
definition: Benchtop pipetting robot from Opentrons with an open source protocol library, built to bring lab automation to ordinary biology labs.

name: Otonaroid
definition: Adult female android by Hiroshi Ishiguro, shown with Kodomoroid at Tokyo's Miraikan science museum in 2014.

name: OTTO 1500
definition: Heavy duty self driving vehicle for factories that moves pallets and large assemblies weighing up to 1,900 kg without floor guidance.

name: Ottobot
definition: An airport and curbside delivery robot rolling through terminals in several countries.

name: Oz
definition: Small electric tool carrier that weeds, sows and marks rows in market garden beds, driving itself between crop rows using satellite guidance.

name: Ozobot
definition: Tiny line following robot that reads coloured codes drawn on paper or a screen, used to teach coding in schools.

name: P3
definition: Honda's first fully self contained walking humanoid, ancestor of ASIMO.

name: P800
definition: The flagship of China's largest AMR fleet, moving shelves in hundreds of warehouses.

name: PackBot
definition: Tracked man portable ground robot used by military and emergency teams, including radiation surveys inside the Fukushima Daiichi buildings.

name: PALRO
definition: Small humanoid communication robot used to lead games and exercises in Japanese care homes for the elderly.

name: Panda
definition: Seven axis arm with torque sensing in every joint, sold at a low price and widely adopted by research laboratories.

name: PaPeRo
definition: Personal robot developed by the Japanese firm NEC, known for its endearing appearance and facial recognition, with work starting in 1997 on the R100 prototype.

name: Paro
definition: Therapeutic robot shaped like a baby harp seal, made to soothe and draw emotional responses from patients in hospitals and care homes, much like animal therapy.

name: Pathfinder
definition: Retrofit autonomy kit that turns conventional orchard and vineyard tractors into driverless machines supervised from a control room by one operator running several tractors.

name: PatrolBot
definition: Service robot made in the United States by ActivMedia Robotics, a company later renamed Mobile Robots Inc.

name: Pave
definition: Robot that finds and seals cracks in asphalt for paving contractors.

name: Peacock Clock
definition: Large eighteenth century automaton clock with three mechanical birds of full life size, created by the businessman James Cox.

name: Peak Robotics KX-2
definition: Collaborative selective compliance assembly robot arm (SCARA) made by Peak Robotics for automating laboratory work in the life sciences.

name: Pepper
definition: Wheeled social humanoid used for greeting and information duties in shops, banks and airports, with about 17,000 units sold before production ended.

name: Perceptive
definition: Robotic system that pairs a new dental imaging method with automated tooth cutting, such as preparing a tooth for a crown.

name: Perseverance
definition: Mars 2020 rover exploring Jezero crater, caching rock cores for possible return to Earth and testing oxygen production from atmospheric carbon dioxide.

name: PETMAN
definition: An anthropomorphic test rig that marched in chemical suits to trial protective clothing.

name: Phantom
definition: Ukrainian military unmanned ground vehicle from Spetstechnoexport, intended for scouting, fire support, carrying ammunition and evacuating wounded soldiers.

name: Philip K. Dick Android
definition: Humanlike android modeled on the science fiction author Philip K. Dick, built by Hanson Robotics in 2005 and able to converse using a model trained on his writings.

name: Phobot
definition: Robot made from Lego by students at the University of Amsterdam that mimics being afraid and conquering fear step by step, intended to help children face phobias.

name: Phoenix
definition: Hydraulically actuated general purpose humanoid built around highly dexterous hands, trialled in a Canadian retail store and with automotive supplier Magna.

name: Phony Pony
definition: Early electrically driven quadruped from USC, generally recognised as the first walking machine in the United States controlled entirely by a computer.

name: PIAP HUNTeR
maker: Industrial Research Institute for Automation and Measurements
definition: Heavy hybrid unmanned ground vehicle developed in Poland by the Industrial Research Institute for Automation and Measurements, weighing 4000 kg and 4.7 m long.

name: Pickle
definition: Mobile robot arm that unloads loose boxes from trucks and trailers onto conveyors.

name: Piggy
definition: Low cost household humanoid from London driven by artificial muscles made of braided tubes rather than electric motors.

name: Pilot Robot Kit
definition: Educational robot kit from the American company True Robotics that pupils in grades 3 to 5 assemble themselves.

name: PINO
maker: Kitano Symbiotic Systems Project, JST ERATO
definition: Small open design humanoid from a Japanese research programme, built from low cost parts and published so other laboratories could copy it.

name: Pio
definition: Scaled down automated storage and retrieval system from the Norwegian company AutoStore, intended for smaller businesses.

name: Pioneer 3-DX
definition: Compact differential drive research base with a sonar array, for years one of the most widely used indoor robot platforms in university laboratories.

name: Piranha Unmanned Surface Vessel
definition: Unmanned surface vessel developed by Zyvex Marine in 2010, kept light by Arovex, a carbon nanotube material used in its construction.

name: Planar Biped
definition: Boom constrained running machine at the MIT Leg Laboratory that set an early bipedal speed record and performed the first robot somersaults.

name: PLEN
definition: Tabletop humanoid toy robot steered from a Bluetooth phone that can ride a skateboard or roller skates and lift, kick and toss small items.

name: Pleo
definition: Animatronic toy dinosaur modelled on a baby Camarasaurus about a week old, designed by Caleb Chung, who helped create the Furby, and first sold by Ugobe.

name: Pluto Plus
definition: Battery powered unmanned underwater vehicle from Italian firm Gaymarine, used by armed forces to identify and destroy sea mines, with a top speed of 6 kt.

name: PM01
definition: Agile mid size humanoid sold for commercial and educational use from about 12,000 dollars, first shown performing an unassisted front flip.

name: Pointman Tactical Robot
definition: Unmanned tactical ground robot intended for military use, built by the American company Applied Research Associates.

name: Poo-Chi
definition: Low cost robotic puppy that walked on four legs, sold worldwide as a cheap toy alternative to expensive entertainment robots.

name: Poppy
definition: Open source 3D printed humanoid from Inria used for developmental robotics experiments and widely adopted in schools and universities.

name: Porton Man
definition: Animatronic humanoid robot made by i-bodi Technology for the Defence Science and Technology Laboratory, used mainly to evaluate protective clothing for British military personnel.

name: PR2
definition: The wheeled two armed research platform that seeded ROS and a generation of manipulation papers.

name: Pragyan
definition: Indian solar rover that explored the high southern latitudes of the Moon for one lunar day after the Chandrayaan-3 landing.

name: Proception
definition: Dexterous robotic hand built for humanoids, aiming at fine work such as threading a needle.

name: Promobot V.4
definition: A wheeled promotional humanoid staffing malls, banks and airports in dozens of countries.

name: PrOP-M
definition: Small tethered walking rover carried by the Mars 2 and Mars 3 landers, intended to skid across the surface on twin skis.

name: Proprio
definition: Robots for building out, maintaining and decommissioning data centers.

name: Proteus
