definition: Untethered acrobatic figure that performs flips and poses in mid air after being launched from a swing.

name: Submerged Dragon 1
definition: Chinese autonomous underwater vehicle, an uncrewed craft that operates beneath the sea surface under its own onboard control.

name: SUMMIT-XL
definition: A Spanish research AMR base common in European labs and EU projects.

name: Surena IV
maker: University of Tehran, Center of Advanced Systems and Technologies
definition: Iranian full size humanoid with 43 degrees of freedom built to a low cost design that replaces force sensors with predictive foot contact sensing.

name: SwarmBot
definition: Lightweight autonomous farm platform that carries third party implements for spraying, mowing and seeding, with several machines working one paddock together.

name: SwiftBot
definition: A premium server robot that reads gestures and dodges crowds.

name: SWIFTI
definition: Small, fast arm from ABB that slows or stops when a person comes near, bridging industrial and collaborative robots.

name: Synphony
definition: Strawberry harvesting robot for California farms, paired with field analytics.

name: SYRANO
definition: French military robot, named for a robotic system for target acquisition and neutralization, that became the first battlefield robot in operational use with the French armed forces.

name: T-52 Enryu
definition: Rescue robot produced by the Japanese robotics company Tmsuk for use in rescue work.

name: T-HR3
definition: A teleoperated avatar humanoid that mirrors its pilot through force feedback exoskeleton controls.

name: T3
definition: Hydraulic industrial robot from Cincinnati Milacron, the first commercially available industrial robot controlled by a minicomputer.

name: T7AMR
definition: Robotic ride on floor scrubber for retail and industrial floors that staff can drive manually or leave to clean a taught route alone.

name: Talisman
definition: Small autonomous submarine made by BAE Systems to reconnoitre coastlines in conditions judged too dangerous or impractical for people to work in.

name: Tally
definition: Slim retail robot that patrols store aisles photographing shelves to find out of stock items, misplaced products and wrong price labels.

name: TALON
definition: A tracked military workhorse for ordnance disposal and reconnaissance.

name: TALOS
definition: Torque controlled full size humanoid sold by PAL Robotics as a platform for whole body control and dynamic locomotion research in industry and academia.

name: Taobotics
definition: Autonomous robots for retail stores from a company based in Shenzhen.

name: TAROS
definition: Military unmanned ground vehicle made by the Czech manufacturer VOP CZ, a robotic platform that operates without a crew aboard.

name: Taurob Inspector
definition: Mobile robot certified under ATEX rules, made by the Austrian firm Taurob for offshore oil and gas sites and derived from its Taurob Tracker.

name: Taurob Tracker
definition: Austrian remote controlled ground robot made by Taurob, first developed for fire brigade reconnaissance and now also used by armed forces, universities and oil and gas companies.

name: teaBOT
definition: Robotic kiosk that blends and brews loose leaf tea to order, placed in offices and showrooms as a workplace amenity.

name: TekBots
definition: Programmable teaching robots that a number of universities use to give students a grounding in the basics of computer and electrical engineering.

name: Tekken-II
definition: Small electric quadruped used to test neural oscillator gait control with reflexes on irregular outdoor ground.

name: Tekno the Robotic Puppy
definition: Electronic robot dog toy launched in late 2000 that became a worldwide hit, with sales passing 40 million in its first four years.

name: TeleMAX
definition: Robot product model offered by Rheinmetall AG, a manufacturer based in Germany.

name: Telenoid
definition: A minimal, ghost like telepresence android reduced to the essence of a person.

name: Teleo
definition: Retrofit that turns dozers, trucks and loaders into supervised autonomous machines so one operator can run several from a control room; the company was acquired.

name: Teletank
definition: Series of experimental Soviet tanks from the 1930s to the early 1940s that ran without crews and were steered by radio from a nearby command tank.

name: temi
definition: A telepresence and assistant robot that follows its owner from room to room.

name: Tenacious
definition: Five kilogram European built micro rover with a scoop and an artwork payload, lost when the Resilience lander crashed in June 2025.

name: Tennibot Rover
definition: Autonomous robot from the company Tennibot that gathers balls by itself, removing the need for a person to collect them.

name: TEO
maker: Universidad Carlos III de Madrid, RoboticsLab
definition: Full size Spanish research humanoid used to study household tasks such as ironing, folding laundry and opening doors.

name: Terabot-S
definition: Robotic manipulator arm from Oceaneering Space Systems that can be mounted on almost any unmanned ground vehicle for jobs such as bomb disposal, mining and hazardous material sampling.

name: TERMES
definition: Team of termite inspired autonomous robots from Harvard University that build structures from blocks by following simple rules, with no central controller, first shown in 2014.

name: Tertill
definition: A solar garden weeding puck from a Roomba co inventor.

name: The Grand Elephant
definition: Giant animatronic elephant built by the French theater company La Machine, about 12 m tall and 8 m wide, with a top speed of 1 km/h.

name: The Trons
definition: Robot band of four machines that play music by themselves, built from spare parts and electronics by Hamilton based musician Greg Locke.

name: THeMIS
definition: A tracked modular military vehicle serving in a dozen armies.

name: Theseus
definition: Magnetic robotic mouse built at Bell Labs in the United States in 1950.

name: Thorvald
definition: Modular battery electric field platform best known for carrying ultraviolet lamps that kill mildew on strawberries and grapes during night passes.

name: Three finger prehensile robot
definition: Gripping unit with three fingers, dating from 1990, designed to fit the end of assembly robots in the car industry and lent by the Laboratoire de robotique de Paris.

name: Throwbot XT
definition: Throwable unmanned ground robot made by ReconRobotics for use by military units and law enforcement agencies.

name: Thymio
definition: A friendly white classroom robot teaching programming to children across Europe.

name: TIAGo
definition: Wheeled robot with a lifting torso and one arm from PAL Robotics, widely used as a research platform for home and care tasks.

name: Tiangong
definition: Full size electrically driven humanoid from a Beijing state backed innovation centre, demonstrated running at about 6 km/h in April 2024.

name: Tico
definition: Spanish social robot made by Adele Robots to engage with people, chiefly at marketing events and in schools as a teacher's assistant.

name: TiLR
definition: Telepresence robot from RoboDynamics Corporation that stands in for a remote user at another location, reducing the need for business travel.

name: TinyLineMarker Pro
definition: Battery electric marking robot that sprays sports field lines and construction layout marks to satellite coordinates loaded from a drawing.

name: Tipu's Tiger
definition: Eighteenth century wooden automaton made for Tipu Sultan of Mysore, depicting a tiger attacking a British man, with a pipe organ inside its body.

name: TITAN VIII
definition: Compact wire driven quadruped from the Hirose laboratory, built as a general purpose walking platform for research and teaching.

name: TITAN XI
definition: Seven tonne hydraulic quadruped built to drill anchor holes on steep slopes, among the largest walking machines ever completed.

name: Tlaloc II-TC
definition: Robot built to explore the tunnel found in 2003 beneath the Temple of the Feathered Serpent at Teotihuacan, the ancient site in central Mexico.

name: TM5
definition: Collaborative arm from Techman Robot with a camera built into the wrist for locating parts.

name: Tobor
definition: Toy robot made in 1978 by Schaper Toys that responded to loud sounds or to a control box through the company's telesonic remote system.

name: TOPIO
definition: Two legged humanoid robot from the Vietnamese firm TOSY, built to compete against people at table tennis.

name: TOPIO Dio
definition: Wheeled humanoid service robot made by the Vietnamese company Tosy to serve customers in restaurants and coffee shops or to mix cocktails.

name: Topo
definition: Series of personal robots produced by Androbot in the 1980s for homes and schools, programmed wirelessly from an Apple II computer.

name: TORO
definition: Torque controlled humanoid from DLR assembled from lightweight robot arm joint modules to test compliant whole body balancing and walking.

name: Torobo
definition: A research grade torque controlled humanoid sold to manipulation labs.

name: Toyota Partner Robot
definition: Series of humanoid robots from Toyota that debuted by playing drums and trumpets at Expo 2005 in Aichi, Japan.

name: Tradinno
definition: Huge animatronic dragon that walks and breathes fire, built to play the dragon in the Drachenstich play in Furth im Wald, Germany.

name: Transcriptic
definition: Remote controlled robotic laboratory where researchers ran life science experiments over the internet.

name: Treads Robot
definition: Educational robot from the American company True Robotics, intended for classroom use from kindergarten through grade 3.

name: Trexo
definition: Powered walking exoskeleton that lets children with conditions such as cerebral palsy take steps, often for the first time.

name: Trilobite
definition: The first mass market robot vacuum cleaner, a disc shaped machine that sensed rooms with ultrasound and returned to its dock to recharge.

name: TRON 1
definition: A multi modal point foot biped platform for locomotion research.

name: Troody
definition: Experimental robot from the United States, dating from 1995, that was designed to imitate a dinosaur.

name: Tuesday
definition: Home robot from a New York startup built to pick up and tidy rooms.

name: TUG T3
definition: Hospital courier robot that tows carts of medication, meals, linen and waste, calling elevators and automatic doors over the building network.

name: TurtleBot
definition: Personal robot kit that runs open source software, first developed at Willow Garage in November 2010 by Melonee Wise and Tully Foote.

name: TurtleBot 4
definition: The standard issue teaching robot of the ROS curriculum.

name: TurtleBot3
definition: Small open source research and teaching robot with a spinning laser scanner, used in university courses and labs to learn mapping and navigation.

name: Tux Droid
definition: Cordless penguin robot styled after Tux, the mascot of Linux, that was manufactured by the company KYSOH and came out around 2007.

name: Twendy-One
definition: A wheeled care humanoid with soft hands able to hold an egg or support a person standing.

name: TyBot
definition: Self propelled gantry robot that rolls along a bridge deck rebar mat and ties intersections automatically without needing a building information model.

name: Type-X
definition: Uncrewed ground combat vehicle from the Estonian firm Milrem Robotics, first presented in 2020 and the company's second robotic vehicle after THeMIS.

name: ULAQ
definition: Armed unmanned surface vessel developed in Turkey, whose prototype was the country's first armed robotic boat.

name: Ultra
definition: General purpose robot for repetitive industrial tasks such as packing, installed in hours without custom integration.

name: Ultra Trencher 1
definition: Submersible trenching robot that buries undersea pipelines by cutting trenches in the seabed, described as the largest submersible robot in the world.

name: Ulysses
definition: Bomb detecting robot used at Athens International Airport Eleftherios Venizelos in Greece, the country's largest international airport.

name: Unimate
definition: Industrial robot regarded as the first of its kind, which went to work on a General Motors assembly line in New Jersey in 1961.

name: Uniroo
definition: One legged robot built in the United States in 1991 and now exhibited at the MIT Museum.

name: Unitree A1
definition: Twelve kilogram electric quadruped that brought dynamic legged research hardware down to a price universities could buy in quantity.

name: Unitree B2
definition: Sixty kilogram industrial quadruped from Unitree rated to walk with forty kilograms of payload for more than four hours.

name: Unitree G1
definition: Compact humanoid priced from around 13,500 dollars, sold in volume to developers, universities and companies as an affordable locomotion and manipulation platform.

name: Unitree Go1
definition: Consumer priced electric quadruped that Unitree marketed as a walking companion, starting at around two thousand seven hundred dollars.

name: Unitree Go2
definition: Fifteen kilogram consumer and developer quadruped with a hemispherical lidar, sold from well under two thousand US dollars.

name: Unitree H1
definition: Full size electric biped sold at a fraction of Western prices, notable for a fast recorded walking speed and for widespread laboratory adoption.

name: Unitree H2
definition: Unitree's flagship full size humanoid with more human proportions and 31 joints, aimed at performance, service and research customers.

name: Unitree R1
definition: Humanoid robot introduced by the Chinese company Unitree Robotics in 2025, standing 123 cm tall.

name: UR10e
definition: Long reach e-Series arm from Universal Robots used for palletising, packaging and machine tending.

name: UR16e
definition: Heavy payload member of the Universal Robots e-Series, built for loading machines and carrying heavy tools.

name: UR20
definition: Redesigned collaborative arm from Universal Robots with new joints, aimed at palletising and welding.

name: UR30
definition: Compact high payload arm from Universal Robots that shares the joint design of the UR20.

name: UR3e
definition: Smallest arm of the Universal Robots e-Series, sized for benchtop assembly and screwdriving.

name: UR5
definition: Six axis arm from Universal Robots that was among the first robots sold to work beside people without a safety cage.

name: UR5e
definition: Medium sized e-Series arm from Universal Robots with a built in force and torque sensor at the tool flange.

name: Uran-9
definition: Russian tracked unmanned combat vehicle from JSC 766 UPTK, offered abroad through Rosoboronexport, that scouts and gives fire support from a distance.

name: Ursula
definition: Ukrainian robotic river boat, built during the Russian invasion, that carries FPV drones and has been nicknamed the world's smallest aircraft carrier.

name: USV Maxlimer
definition: Uncrewed surface vessel run by the British firm SEA-KIT International that can work semi autonomously or under remote control, and won the Shell Ocean Discovery X Prize.

name: USV RSV
definition: Unmanned surface vessel developed since 2008 by the founders of the company Marine Tech SAS.

name: USX-1 Defiant
definition: Uncrewed surface warship built for DARPA as a technology demonstrator, completed in February 2025, with sea trials beginning a month later.

name: UVD Robot
definition: Mobile ultraviolet disinfection robot that drives itself around hospital rooms and exposes surfaces to short wavelength light after manual cleaning.

name: UWA Telerobot
definition: Remotely operated robot dating from 1996, run by the University of Western Australia's School of Mechanical and Civil Engineering.

name: Vaimos
maker: IFREMER and École nationale supérieure de techniques avancées Bretagne
definition: French autonomous sailing boat carrying onboard instruments for measuring the ocean surface, developed by IFREMER and ENSTA Bretagne.

name: Valkyrie
definition: NASA's first walking humanoid, built in about fifteen months for the 2013 DARPA Robotics Challenge and later loaned to university laboratories.

name: Vanderbilt exoskeleton
definition: Powered exoskeleton from Vanderbilt University's Center for Intelligent Mechatronics, sold as Indego, meant to help people affected by paraplegia, stroke or other forms of paralysis walk on their own.

name: Vassar
definition: Gearless robot joints and arms driven by high torque transverse flux motors, built for AI research labs.

name: Vaucanson Flute Player
definition: Android automaton built by Jacques de Vaucanson that played a standard transverse flute of the period, imitating a human flautist; it was first exhibited in 1738.

name: Vector
definition: A palm sized desk companion with big eyes and a cloud brain, revived by its fans.

name: VELYS Robotic-Assisted Solution
definition: Orthopedic surgical robot introduced by DePuy in 2021 to assist surgeons with total knee replacement operations.

name: Versatran
definition: Cylindrical coordinate industrial robot from American Machine and Foundry, one of the earliest robots put to work in a factory.

name: Versius
definition: Modular surgical robot from CMR Surgical whose arms sit on separate carts so they can be arranged around the operating table.

name: VertiGo
maker: ETH Zurich and Disney Research Zurich
definition: Remote controlled wall climbing robot on wheels, developed by ETH Zurich and Disney Research Zurich, that uses two fully tilting propellers to push itself onto and up walls.

name: VEX IQ
definition: Snap together plastic robotics kit used by schools and in the VEX IQ competitions.

name: VideoRay ROVs
definition: Family of inspection class underwater remotely operated vehicles, each run from a control unit about the size of a suitcase and tethered by copper or fiber optic cable.

name: VIPER
definition: Golf cart sized NASA rover built to hunt water ice at the lunar south pole with a metre long drill and neutron detector.

name: Vision 60
definition: Rugged electric quadruped from Philadelphia sold mainly to defence and security customers for patrol and reconnaissance work.

name: Vitirover
definition: Small solar powered grazing robot that trims grass between vine rows and along railway verges, working inside a geofenced plot for days unattended.

name: Vityaz-D
definition: Russian fully autonomous deep submergence vehicle built to reach full ocean depth, with a mass of 5650 kg.

name: VolcanoBot 2
definition: Small two wheeled tethered robot built to crawl into volcanic fissures at Kilauea and map their inner shape in three dimensions.

name: Vyommitra
maker: Indian Space Research Organisation, Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre
definition: Half humanoid robot built by ISRO to fly on uncrewed Gaganyaan test missions and monitor cabin systems in place of a crew.

name: W3
definition: A hotel and building courier that rides lifts and passes through doors on its own.

name: WABIAN-2R
definition: Full size biped used at Waseda to study human like walking, carrying a movable waist and trunk plus a passive toe joint.

name: WABOT-1
definition: Full scale anthropomorphic robot built at Waseda University that walked on two legs, gripped objects and held simple spoken exchanges.

name: WABOT-2
definition: Keyboard playing humanoid from Waseda University that read printed sheet music with a camera eye and performed on an electronic organ.

name: Wakamaru
definition: Yellow domestic robot from Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, built to interact with people in a natural way and offered only to Japanese households from 2005.

name: WALK-MAN
definition: Full size compliant humanoid built for European disaster response research and later tested in earthquake damaged buildings in Amatrice, Italy.

name: Walker
definition: UBTech's first full size home humanoid, shown serving drinks at CES.

name: Walker Chess player
definition: Purported chess playing automaton built in the 1820s by the Walker Brothers of Baltimore, Maryland, as a rival to the Turk, a widely known chess machine.

name: Walker S
definition: An industrial humanoid piloted on automotive lines for quality inspection and assembly; deployed in fleets.

name: Walker S2
definition: Industrial humanoid that swaps its own battery in about three minutes, sold to Chinese carmakers and electronics plants for continuous shift work.

name: Walking Truck
definition: Hydraulic four legged vehicle from General Electric that an operator drove by moving his own arms and legs inside a force feedback harness.

name: Wanda
definition: A wheeled home humanoid pitched at laundry and dishwashing.

name: Warthog
definition: An amphibious heavyweight research vehicle for mines, farms and shorelines.

name: Wave Glider
definition: Ocean surface robot whose submerged wing converts the motion of waves into forward thrust, with solar panels for its instruments.

name: Wheelbarrow
definition: Remote controlled bomb disposal robot created in 1972 for British Army teams and used in Iraq, Northern Ireland and mainland Britain.

name: Whiz
definition: A vacuum sweeper trained by walking it once, then set loose on office carpets.

name: WildCat
definition: Untethered petrol powered quadruped built to run fast in the open, the free running successor to the treadmill bound Cheetah.

name: Winbot
definition: Window cleaning robot from Ecovacs that holds itself to the glass by suction and wipes in a set pattern.

name: WonderBorg
definition: Programmable six legged robot kit shaped like a beetle, released by Bandai in 2000 for use with the WonderSwan and Windows PCs.

name: Workerbot
definition: Industrial robot from pi4 robotics GmbH whose movement and sensing abilities are modelled on those of a human.

name: WowWee Alive Chimpanzee
definition: Animatronic chimpanzee head from the WowWee Alive division of WowWee that uses motors and sensors to copy a live chimpanzee's facial expressions.

name: XAG R150
definition: Compact wheeled farm vehicle that sprays orchards and carries loads along mapped routes, controlled from a phone and positioned by satellite reference stations.

name: xArm 6
definition: Low cost six axis arm from UFactory popular with universities and small workshops.

name: XGO-Mini
definition: A desktop quadruped with an arm on its back for pick and place tricks.

name: Xianxingzhe
definition: First bipedal humanoid built in China, a 140 cm machine that walked at about two steps per second and was announced in November 2000.

name: Xiaomanlv
definition: Low speed autonomous parcel van that delivers packages on Chinese university campuses and residential districts, developed by Alibaba and operated by its Cainiao logistics arm.

name: XM1216 SUGV
definition: Small, man portable military ground robot derived from iRobot's PackBot and built for the Future Combat Systems programme.

name: XMAN-R1
definition: A wheeled embodied service humanoid from the restaurant robot leader.

name: XR-2
definition: Educational robot manufactured by Rhino Robotics as a teaching tool for training students in robotics.

name: XV-11

name: Yaoki

name: Yarbo
definition: A modular yard robot that swaps between snow blowing, mowing and leaf blowing bodies.

name: Yeti
definition: Four wheeled polar survey robot that tows radar over Antarctic and Greenland ice to find crevasses and buried structures.

name: youBot
definition: Small omnidirectional base with a five axis arm, sold by KUKA to universities for research and teaching.

name: YuMi

name: Yummy Future

name: Yutu-2

name: Zenbo
definition: A rolling home assistant that read bedtime stories in Taiwanese households.

name: Zeta Surgical

name: ZEUS
definition: Surgical robot with arms controlled from a separate console, withdrawn after its maker merged with Intuitive Surgical in 2003.

name: ZEUS Robotic Surgical System
definition: Surgical robot made by Computer Motion that had three remotely controlled arms, won FDA clearance in 2001 and was dropped in 2003 after the merger with Intuitive Surgical.

name: Zhurong
definition: China's first Mars rover, which explored southern Utopia Planitia for a year and found evidence of water altered soils and buried shorelines.

name: Zoë
definition: Solar powered astrobiology rover used in the Atacama Desert, the first robot to detect and map life autonomously in a desert.

name: Zoomer
definition: Interactive toy robot dog that responded to voice commands and learned tricks.
